title: semanticdf manifest
description: JSON Schema for the semanticdf `SemanticManifest` artifact. v0.1.11+; older schemaVersions parse via the prefix-match gate but are not validated by this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Wire-format version of the manifest. Bumped on backwards-incompatible changes. v0.1.9, v0.1.10, v0.1.11 are all valid.

kind.description: Discriminator between single-table and joined-manifest kinds. Currently only single-table is implemented; joined is a future recipe.

compiledAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this artifact was emitted.

manifestVersion.description: Semver of the manifest spec. Pre-1.0 (0.x.x) for evolving specs; 1.0.0+ for stable. Defaults to '0.1.0' if absent.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema document for validation. Tooling can fetch this and validate the manifest shape.

id.description: Reverse-DNS FQN of the model. Globally unique. Used for cross-referencing between manifests (joined-manifest recipe, future lineage work).

namespace.description: Multi-env deployment scoping (e.g. 'dev', 'prod', 'team-X'). Defaults to 'default' if absent.

metadata.description: Free-form audit object. Flat string values only (recipe §11 Q7). Conventional keys: author, license, tags, sourceRepo, sourceCommit.

runtime.description: Runtime tuning options for the model. Preserved across the manifest round-trip so YAML-deploys can carry non-default tuning. Missing `runtime` block → use library defaults. Only emitted when at least one field is non-default.

maxRows.description: Driver-memory safety cap on rows. 0 disables the cap (escape hatch, mirrors the fluent chain convention).

broadcastJoinThreshold.description: Opt-in auto-broadcast threshold for join_one/join_many, in bytes. Absent means no library override (Spark's autoBroadcastJoinThreshold applies).

materializeLevel.description: Opt-in DataFrame persistence (Spark StorageLevel) for the fast path of toDataFrame. Encoded as 5 fields (useDisk/useMemory/useOffHeap/deserialized/replication) for lossless round-trip of all 13 standard named StorageLevels and any custom-built instance. Absent means no persist (the library default).

useOffHeap.description: Allow storage in off-heap memory (requires spark.memory.offHeap.enabled=true).

deserialized.description: Store as deserialized Java objects (true) or serialized bytes (false). Serialized reduces memory but adds CPU.

replication.description: Replication factor (1 = no replication; >1 trades memory for fault tolerance).

single-table-manifest.description: Per-side embedded single-table manifest inside a joined envelope (PR #151).
